title: Trial to harvest mapping for one synthetic wheat trial
scientificQuestion: Can an independent system recover, for each plot in a wheat trial, the cultivar planted, the irrigation actually applied, the relevant soil and weather context, and the measured grain yield?

miappe.name: MIAPPE
miappe.note: BrAPI v2.1 schema descriptions cite MIAPPE V1.1. MIAPPE v1.2 (October 2024) exists but is not the version referenced by the inspected BrAPI v2.1 contracts.

findings.relationship: The cultivar is the Germplasm referenced by the plot's ObservationUnit and/or HarvestRecord; BrAPI Germplasm is the canonical cultivar identity.
findings.spatialContext: Cultivar identity is not spatial; site/plot linkage is carried by ObservationUnit and Location.
findings.temporalContext: Germplasm identity is stable across seasons; season is carried by Study/BrAPI Season.

findings.acceptanceCondition: Given a plot's observationUnitDbId, an independent client resolves germplasmDbId and retrieves a Germplasm record naming the cultivar; a fixture with an unresolvable germplasmDbId fails.

findings.reason: BrAPI v2.1 ObservationUnit is explicitly defined as the physical entity being observed and commonly a plot, with germplasm and position; this is the interoperable experimental-unit contract.
findings.acceptanceCondition: An independent client lists ObservationUnits for the study and identifies plot-level units by observationLevel and germplasmDbId.

findings.acceptanceCondition: A FieldGeometry record includes locationDbId or plotDbId (or an external reference) plus crs and area, and a fixture that treats geometry alone as a plot is rejected.

findings.relationship: BrAPI ObservationUnit carries ObservationTreatment with factor and modality, representing planned treatments such as low/high water.
findings.spatialContext: Treatment is attached to the ObservationUnit, which carries position/geoCoordinates.

workedTrace.title: One worked record trace (synthetic wheat trial)
workedTrace.prose: Trial 'wheat-trial-network-2026' (BrAPI Trial) contains Study 'wheat-yield-trial-2026' (BrAPI Study) at Location 'field-12' (BrAPI Location, WGS84 coordinates). The study has two cultivars, 'cv-alpha' and 'cv-beta' (BrAPI Germplasm), and two planned irrigation levels, 'low-water' and 'high-water'. Each of the four plots is a BrAPI ObservationUnit carrying germplasmDbId, observationLevel='plot', position, and ObservationTreatment with factor='irrigation' and the assigned modality; this is the planned treatment. GenX Plot records (plotDbId) exist for the same four plots but, because the current schema has no observationUnitDbId or studyDbId, an external mapping table is required to join plotDbId to observationUnitDbId. Soil context comes from a GenX SoilProfile at location 'field-12' with sampledAt and soil properties; however, the current schema has no sampling depth and no plot link, so the profile is site-level and its depth interval is unstated. Weather context comes from GenX WeatherObservation records for station 'ws-07' at location 'field-12' with observedAt timestamps and measurements; they are site/station-level and their aggregation window and representativeness are unstated. Applied irrigation is recorded as GenX IrrigationEvent records with locationDbId='field-12', studyDbId='wheat-yield-trial-2026', irrigatedAt, method, volume, and volumeUnit; because there is no plotDbId or observationUnitDbId, these events are field/study-level and cannot be attributed to an individual plot without an external rule. Measured grain yield is recorded either as a BrAPI Observation for each plot's ObservationUnit (value, timestamp, grain-yield variable) or as a GenX HarvestRecord with quantity, unit, moisture, moistureUnit, and areaHarvested; the HarvestRecord has no plot/observationUnit link and no moisture-basis rule, so yield comparison across plots requires an external convention. FieldGeometry may describe the field boundary and area, but it has no location or plot link in the current schema, so it cannot by itself identify the harvested experimental unit.

negativeCases.title: Wrong-plot irrigation event
negativeCases.description: An IrrigationEvent is recorded with locationDbId matching the trial field but is attributed to plot B, although the water was applied to plot A.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag the attribution because the current IrrigationEvent schema has no plotDbId/observationUnitDbId or documented distribution rule.

negativeCases.title: Soil data with no sampling depth
negativeCases.description: A SoilProfile is recorded with locationDbId and sampledAt but no sampling depth, and its nutrient values are used to interpret plot performance.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or mark incomplete because the depth interval to which the values apply is unstated.

negativeCases.title: Yield with an ambiguous measurement basis
negativeCases.description: A HarvestRecord states quantity and unit but omits moisture, moistureUnit, areaHarvested, and moisture basis, or an Observation variable scale does not state moisture basis.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag because grain yield cannot be compared across plots without a stated moisture basis and harvested area.

unknowns: Whether GenX Plot is intended to replace, mirror, or supplement the BrAPI ObservationUnit plot level.
Whether soil sampling depth should be a property of SoilProfile or a separate sample record with horizon semantics.
Whether weather station representativeness radius, sensor height, and aggregation window belong in WeatherObservation or in station metadata.
Whether IrrigationEvent volume is per field, per plot, or per application zone, and how application efficiency/runoff should be recorded.
Whether HarvestRecord quantity is as-harvested or dry mass, and what standard moisture basis (for example 14% for wheat) applies.
Whether cultivar identity should be BrAPI Germplasm or a GenX crop-species/taxon reference for this trial.
Whether planned treatment assignment should be BrAPI ObservationTreatment, GenX TreatmentAssignment, or both with an explicit link.
